text.headline: The "free" camel ride at Petra costs $70
beats: A handler offers a free ride to the viewpoint. Free is the trap.
At the top he blocks the camel until you pay 50 JOD. Or 70. Or 100.
Your 50 JOD ticket already includes the horse ride from the gate. Walk the rest, or agree a written price first.
text.close: Send this to whoever is going to Jordan
